findings: five full-body reference panels are 307x710 or 308x710, but the initial trainer center-cropped every image to 384x512; the crop retained only about 58 percent of the original height
the initial evaluation used only the trigger token plus a generic subject prompt, although every training caption carried the full appearance description
the trigger p7mira tokenizes to p, 7, and mira while the text encoder is frozen; it is not a newly learned single-token identity binding
the 19 training panels are mostly isolated white-background character views, so they do not teach the base model to combine the character with a webtoon scene
next_run_requirements: restart from the base model after aspect-ratio-preserving resize and white padding only; do not resume the cropped checkpoints
compare trigger-only and full-identity anchor prompts before held-out scene evaluation
use a webtoon-compatible SD 1.5 base model or split style learning from character identity learning
treat text-encoder adaptation or a learned identity embedding as a separate, memory-measured experiment

style_adapter_scope_diagnostic.purpose: separate a non-working style adapter from scene-composition-only degradation
style_adapter_scope_diagnostic.fixed_conditions: WD base, Mira checkpoint 100 at 0.35, pack 02 style checkpoint 300, identical seed per row, style strengths 0.0/0.1/0.2/0.35
style_adapter_scope_diagnostic.result: even the pure-white anchor did not converge to the approved clean reference line art. With the style adapter enabled it introduced character-sheet-like fragments, duplicate faces, and changed proportions. Scenes retained the WD high-saturation/manga prior and the adapter sometimes intensified it
diagnosis: the 16 panel sources teach isolated white-background character-sheet composition but contain no equivalent scene/background examples, so the adapter learns a content-layout shortcut rather than a scene-independent rendering rule
the Mira identity adapter and the style adapter both change the same UNet q/k/v/out attention modules; composition is additive but not guaranteed to separate identity from rendering mode
a small generated style-only dataset cannot counter the selected WD base's strong color, shading, and line-art prior
style_adapter_scope_diagnostic.decision: reject this style adapter architecture for the webtoon-cut pipeline. Do not claim style consistency from it; evaluate candidate base models without either LoRA before retraining character identity
